svg.title: stable-sinks
svg.desc: Toy 12-token causal attention. Vanilla softmax: rows with nothing to read dump weight on token 0, which becomes a sink. With a learned per-head sink logit z_h the extra column outside the sequence absorbs that mass and token 0 is ordinary; rows sum to less than 1. One query with six equal logits: vanilla must give each key 0.167; with z_h = 3 the sink takes 0.77 and each key 0.038, so the head outputs almost nothing. Cost: one scalar per head, 2,304 parameters in gpt-oss-120b. MiMo-V2-Flash at window 128 reports MMLU 54.9 to 58.3 with the sink.
